name: Lunu
subtitle: Salt, fire and the morning catch
intro: Lunu means salt in Sinhala. Our restaurant cooks over coconut-husk fire, with fish bought each morning from Tangalle harbour, spices from the garden and recipes from the southern coast.
note: Lunu is part of the fictional AUREL resort. Dishes and prices are illustrative.

highlights.title: From the morning catch
highlights.text: Fish arrives from the boats at dawn and is cooked the same day, most often as ambul thiyal, the sour fish curry of the south.

highlights.title: A spice garden
highlights.text: Curry leaves, pandan, lemongrass and chillies grow a few steps from the kitchen.

highlights.title: Cooked over fire
highlights.text: The open grill burns dried coconut husks, giving everything a gentle smoke.
